rationale: No debits for build, BP, A1c, family history, occupation, driving, liver or financials. Cholesterol 323 (75) and ratio 5.3 (25) point at different bands, so I used judgement: adding both gives 175, charging the worse alone 150; either is Table 6. Tobacco quit within 5 years adds 25; diagnosed, untreated sleep apnea adds 50. No modifiers. Nearest precedent with clean lipids rated Table 2 on tobacco and apnea, consistent with this.
